answer: A farm of 263 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in lantern, queued in delta, and lagoon publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 66 identities per epoch. A farm of 4786 identities would post 3466 proofs and burn roughly 16 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
